page.overview:
Who is Alien Infiltrator?

Alien Infiltrator, known as Alien Vader in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card, "Alien Infiltrator".

Alien Infiltrator appears in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008. It appears as a Tag Duel opponent and it Tag partner is Alien Shocktrooper.

They can be unlocked if the player has beaten them in World four Darkness. Their team name is A-Type Gene.
